title: Knowledge Cache State
description: UC7KS knowledge cache state — tracks cache health, agent compliance, and pipeline bypass attempts. Added Phase 4 hardening (FW-HARDEN-UC7KS).

cache_status.description: Overall health status of the local knowledge cache.

last_index_check.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last time index.json was verified.

last_fetch_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent @Knowledge-Curator fetch.

total_bypass_attempts.description: Total number of bypass attempts (direct external queries without cache check).

bypass_attempts_by_agent.description: Bypass attempts keyed by agent type.

cache_hits.description: Number of times agents successfully used cached docs.

cache_misses.description: Number of times agents needed docs not in cache.

pipeline_integrity.description: Integrity verification of the knowledge pipeline.

verified_count.description: Number of cache files verified in last integrity check.

mismatch_count.description: Number of hash mismatches found in last integrity check.

session_access.description: UC7-001 per-agent cache access tracking. Records when each agent type last read docs/official_docs/index.json. Used by compliance_gate_check and uc7ks-enforcer to enforce the 'local-first' mandate. Keyed by agent type (e.g. '@Super-Admin', '@Coder-BE'). Added FW-HARDEN-UC7KS-001.

last_read_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent cache index read.

last_file_read.description: Last cache file path that was read (e.g., 'docs/official_docs/index.json').

uc7_001_compliant.description: Whether this agent has satisfied UC7-001 (read local cache before proceeding).

total_cache_reads.description: Total number of times this agent has read cache files.

declared_scope.description: Agent's declared module domain from knowledge_semantic_map (e.g., 'backend_api', 'persistence'). Set by module_scope_declare tool. FW-HARDEN-UC7KS-002.

declared_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the agent declared its module scope.

cache_sufficiency.description: Agent's cache sufficiency declaration. Required before external queries in strict/locked mode. FW-HARDEN-UC7KS-003. UC7-001c HARDEN: reason, files_read, content_summary are REQUIRED evidence fields.

status.description: Whether the local cache covers the agent's knowledge needs.

reason.description: WHY the cache is sufficient or insufficient. Required by UC7-001c.

files_read.description: Cache file paths that were read (e.g., 'opencode/framework/plugins.md'). Required by UC7-001c.

content_summary.description: Brief summary of what was found in the cached files. Required by UC7-001c.

missing_topics.description: Specific topics the agent found missing in cache.

declared_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when sufficiency was declared.
